subject: The 2AM setup our top 1% use
preview_text: I asked 100 power users how they set up Smart Notes. Their answer changed how I use the app.
body_paragraphs: I spent last Tuesday 3AM digging into how the top 1% of Smart Notes users set up their workflow. The pattern was so consistent I had to share it with you. They don't just record meetings—they build a system that saves them hours every single week.

Here's the move: they enable language-aware transcription and lock in their meeting language before the first call. While everyone else scrambles to fix messy transcripts, these users get clean, searchable text from the first tap. One founder told me it cut his note-taking time by 70%.

You can do this in seconds. Open the app, go to your profile, set your profile language and default meeting language. That's it—your summaries will be sharper, your action items clearer, and you'll never waste time decoding a garbled transcript again.

Try it now. Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary, update your language settings, and record your next meeting. P.S. The top 1% also share their summaries instantly—after you set this up, tap the share icon to send action items to your team. That's the real power move.
